text:
Ari: Found a sticky note on the Keurig that says "thermostat is plotting". Are we living in a thriller? :thinking_face:
Bea: Plot twist: thermostat is an improv comedian. It only tells cold jokes. :cold_face: :joy:
Diego: Proposal: Thermostat Accord. Simple rules: agreed temp band, a pastry penalty for rogue adjustments, and an honorary office mascot.
Samir: Honorary mascot nomination: Earl the paperclip (I found him during a phone call). He already has gravitas.
Ari: Pact draft: 70-73F preferred. If someone cranks it above 75, they bring a box of croissants. If below 68, hot chocolate for the team. Fair?
Bea: Can FacilitiesBot calendar a weekly "Temp Check" for 10 minutes? Quick vent slot. :raised_hand:
FacilitiesBot: Event created: "Temp Check" recurring Wednesdays 09:30. (Created by FacilitiesBot)
Diego: Also: whoever changes the temp manually needs to post a selfie with the tiny Earl sticker for dignity and accountability. Photo mandatory.
Samir: Addendum: winners of the weekly sticker contest get the temporary Slack nickname "Earlkeeper" for a week. Low stakes, high morale.
Ari: I'm drafting a one-line for the handbook: "Earl and the Thermostat Accord: respect the balance, respect the Keurig." Thoughts?
Bea: Perfect. Also can we make an enamel pin? Small cost, infinite lore.
FacilitiesBot: Reminder set: "Submit Thermostat Accord draft" in 4 days. (Created by FacilitiesBot)
Diego: Pact accepted. Meeting adjourned. Long live Earl. :paperclip: :gavel:
